goal: Drive a fixture through the real orchestrate loop with scripted invoker and summarizer seams so a full summarize-restart is both produced and applied end-to-end: Outcome.RECOVERED recorded, recovery attempt started, `# Recovery handoff` in the second prompt, and a persisted harness.context_recovery event.

references: .workflow/specs/00018-FEATURE-context-recovery-policy.md FR-7 (real loop drives a full summarize-restart) and FR-3/FR-5 (both loop-produced ends + persisted event)
tests/test_worker.py::test_run_once_merges_completed_task -- model for driving a full real-loop cycle with a scripted invoke against a real store
src/flywheel/grader_rubric.py JudgeInvoke seam -- the recovery_summarizer_invoke seam is scripted the same way
constraints: FR-3: drive BOTH loop-produced ends -- the harness PRODUCING recovery (RECOVERED finalize + harness.context_recovery event) AND APPLYING it (the next attempt actually starts and its prompt carries `# Recovery handoff`). Stubbing either end fails the slot.

Use the existing injectable invoker seam fed a deterministic scripted envelope whose usage crosses context_recovery_trigger_ratio (set context_window_tokens on the real HarnessConfig), plus a scripted recovery_summarizer_invoke -- never call a paid/network agent.

Assert against the real persisted store: Outcome.RECOVERED on the first attempt, AttemptStarted for the recovery attempt, the harness.context_recovery event present and ordered before that AttemptStarted, and the summarizer's content in the second attempt's prompt.
Do not stub orchestrate, harness, SqliteStore, or the summarizer runner -- only the agent's text and the summarizer's returned text are scripted.
Never read, write, or migrate .workflow/flywheel.sqlite -- fixture/temp stores only.
Tag MUST include `in-loop-verification` verbatim -- archive_completed_phases keys off this exact tag.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (test: ... or feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: FR-4's v(N-1) store-seeding + forward-migration clause does NOT apply: this feature adds no schema column/table (spec Decisions Log) -- do not seed or migrate a prior-version store.
Do not auto-generate the fixture or assertions; the human authoring the slot writes the test body.
Do not test compact/fork, a recover control verb, or mid-turn recovery -- all out of scope.
